segments.sn35.109:1.3: Katame ca, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyā dhammā, katamañca saṃyojanaṃ?
segments.sn35.109:1.5: Yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ … pe … jivhā saṃyojaniyo dhammo … pe … mano saṃyojaniyo dhammo.
segments.sn35.109:1.8: Yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.109:1.9: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyā dhammā, idaṃ saṃyojanan”ti.
